generator.description: Apparent geocentric Moon of date at 1757 instants over 1990..2060 from Skyfield + JPL DE440s, with DE421 as a cross-check.

ephemeris_crosscheck.note: DE421 ends 2053-10-09; later instants are DE440s only

frame.bright_limb_angle_deg: skyfield.trigonometry.position_angle_of((dec, ra) of the Moon, (dec, ra) of the Sun), both apparent of date: the position angle of the Sun from the Moon's centre, north through east, which is the position angle of the bright limb's midpoint (Meeus eq. 48.5). Ill-defined within a few degrees of new or full moon.
frame.computed_as: earth.at(t).observe(moon).apparent().radec(epoch='date'); GHA = normalise(t.gast * 15 - RA) into [0, 360). The light-time solution uses barycentric positions and aberration uses the Earth's barycentric velocity, which for the Moon cancel to about 1 mas and leave the geocentric position at the retarded time t - r/c (about 0.7 arcsec from the geometric one).
frame.definition: Apparent geocentric of date (CONVENTIONS section 7): true equator and equinox of date.
frame.distance_km: geometric geocentric distance at t, (moon - earth).at(t)
frame.distance_km_light_time: length of the apparent position vector (light-time distance)
frame.ecliptic: frame_latlon(skyfield.framelib.ecliptic_frame): true ecliptic and equinox of date
frame.elongation_deg: separation of the apparent Moon and the apparent Sun seen from the geocentre
frame.gha_columns: gha_deg uses the UT1 of SkyFix Lab's own timescale (the IERS table on the UTC scale); gha_deg_dut1_zero is the same GHA with UT1 = UTC (common.gha_dut1_zero_deg), the CONVENTIONS section 6 convention. After 2035 the clock is UT1 and they coincide. Test DUT1 = 0 implementations against gha_deg_dut1_zero.
frame.phase_angle_deg: Skyfield ICRF.phase_angle(sun) on the astrometric Moon: Sun-Moon-Earth angle with light-time

frame_of_date.inside_validated_tier: Skyfield's own frame of date: IAU 2006 precession (P03), IAU 2006 mean obliquity and GMST, IAU 2000A nutation
frame_of_date.outside_validated_tier: common.use_app_frame(): the Vondrak-Capitaine-Wallace 2011 long-term precession with the IERS 2010 frame bias (ltp.ltpb, ERFA eraLtpb), its mean obliquity, and GMST = ERA + the long-term accumulated precession (ltp.gmst_minus_era_samples); IAU 2000A nutation
frame_of_date.switch: by TT one day outside 1550-01-01 and 2650-01-22 (JD 2287184.5 and 2688974.5), as the Rust side (tiers::MODEL_SWITCH_MARGIN_DAYS)

generator.never_a_runtime_dependency: Generated by tools/reference/ (Python + Skyfield). CONVENTIONS section 11: never regenerate a fixture from Rust output.

timescale.clock: the app's clock (CONVENTIONS 15.2): UTC 1972-01-01 .. 2035-12-31, UT (= UT1) outside; clock_time() turns a clock instant into TT and UT1
timescale.delta_t_source: SkyFix Lab's own Delta T (crates/skyfix-core/src/deltat/data.rs): Stephenson, Morrison & Hohenkerk 2016/2020 splines, the IERS weekly table 1973 on, the long-term parabola beyond, joined as Skyfield 1.55 joins them
timescale.dut1_zero: gha_deg_dut1_zero columns use dut1_zero_timescale(): UT1 = UTC on the UTC scale (the Nautical Almanac's and USNO's convention), the model's UT1 outside

generator.tolerance_justification: The CONVENTIONS 13.7 targets: Moon GHA and Dec worst 0.1 arcmin, HP worst 0.05 arcmin, illuminated fraction worst 0.001. The reference is far inside them: DE421 and DE440s agree on the Moon's apparent direction to 0.0061 arcsec and on its distance to 0.0009 km over the 1515 instants both cover.

name: moon_geocentric
notes: Instants are whole seconds on the app's clock. Random instants are uniform over 1990-01-01T00:00:00Z .. 2060-12-31T23:59:59Z; extremes are found with DE440s (skyfield.searchlib, 1-day steps) and rounded to the nearest second, so each is within a second of the true extreme.

The clock is UTC 1972-2035 and UT outside it (CONVENTIONS 15.2), with SkyFix Lab's own Delta T; jd_tt and jd_ut1 give each case's TT and UT1. dut1_s is UT1 - UTC from SkyFix Lab's IERS table (Bulletin A's prediction, then the Delta T model, past its end) and 0 on the UT part of the clock; gha_deg carries it and gha_deg_dut1_zero does not.
